stations.title: Mount window regulator
stations.does: Places the window regulator onto the carrier and fastens it with 4 screws.
steps: Stop pallet carrier at ST1 index position.
Clamp/locate the trim carrier fixture to present regulator mounting holes.
Pick the window regulator from a nearby presented location (operator-assisted/assisted pick).
Move regulator over the carrier and lower to align mounting holes.
Drive 4 screws in a cross pattern using the automatic/assisted screwdriver at pre-set torque/length.
Verify screw drive completion (sensor/torque confirmation) and that regulator sits flush.

stations.title: Install speaker
stations.does: Fits the speaker and fastens it with 3 screws.
steps: Index the pallet carrier to ST2.
Locate/locate-align the speaker to the defined mounting features on the carrier.
Move speaker into position and seat it against the locating surfaces.
Drive 3 screws (operator initiates, automatic/assisted screwdriver drives) in a stable pattern.
Confirm screw-driving status (torque/success signal) and speaker flush seating.

stations.title: Connect wiring harness
stations.does: Lays the wiring harness and plugs it into the regulator and speaker.
steps: Index the pallet carrier to ST3.
Route/lift wiring harness onto the carrier in the defined harness path (guided by clips/edge guides).
Plug the harness regulator connector into the regulator port until audible/visual latch confirmation.
Plug the harness speaker connector into the speaker port until latch confirmation.
Tuck/clip slack so it clears moving parts and does not obstruct fastener points.
Check harness continuity visually (connector seated, no pinched sections) within station budget.

stations.title: Window motor + speaker test
stations.does: Switch on and check the window motor and speaker function.
steps: Index the pallet carrier to ST4 and engage electrical test interface (pogo pins/connector interface).
Power on the DUT for test mode.
Command window motor up/down cycle (within regulator capabilities) and monitor motor run/response current/time thresholds.
Trigger speaker output test (command tone/level) and confirm expected signal response (pass/fail criterion).
Record PASS/REJECT verdict to station system.
If REJECT: signal downstream operator for separated handling (exact movement/rework routing not specified).
Power down and release electrical interface; allow pallet to proceed.

notes: Quality handling for REJECT is not specified beyond separation; the plan assumes ST4 records PASS/REJECT and provides an operator action to divert/rework outside this line or to a defined buffer (to be detailed).
All station takt budgets are set ≤ 90 s (takt from 40/h); ST4 is the current line bottleneck at 80 s. If actual test cycle is slower, the line takt will need retiming or test method optimization.
The product size/fixture behavior is assumed to fit on a single pallet conveyor carrier; if the carrier/pallet geometry differs, fixture indexing and alignment details must be updated.
